summary: Frontend-only regression + bug-fix verification for /app/frontend/app/onboarding.tsx. Confirmed the TouchableWithoutFeedback wrapper removal resolves the 'im not able to enter name num' bug. Typing works in input-name, input-phone, and input-vehicle. Passenger and Driver flows both navigate correctly. Error state and phone maxLength=10 also verified. No react-native deprecated-package issues detected on this screen.
critical_code_review_comments: Console warning noted (non-blocking): '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Originates from SHADOW.card in theme; consider migrating to boxShadow for RN 0.76+ web compatibility.
Phone input has keyboardType='phone-pad' + maxLength=10 but no numeric-only sanitizer; user could still paste non-digits. Consider onChangeText={(v)=>setPhone(v.replace(/\D/g,''))}.
seed_data_creation: None. Passwordless onboarding registered TEST users 'Priya Kumar' (passenger) and 'Ravi Driver' (driver, TN09AB1234) via /api/register.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Onboarding bug fully fixed. To reset app state to onboarding, run localStorage.clear() then reload; the root index redirects unauthenticated users to /onboarding. Passenger home renders after successful passenger register; Driver home renders after driver register.
rca_of_issue: Root cause (already fixed by main agent): onboarding.tsx previously wrapped the ScrollView with <TouchableWithoutFeedback onPress={Keyboard.dismiss}>. On web/RN, that gesture wrapper captured taps before they reached TextInput children, so tapping name/phone did not focus the input and no keyboard/typing occurred. Removing the wrapper (verified in current file, lines 72-195) restored native focus behavior. Test steps that reproduced+verified: 1) Clear storage → load /, 2) tap input-name and type 'Priya Kumar' → value updates, 3) tap input-phone and type '9876543210' → value updates and maxLength caps at 10, 4) submit empty → error 'Enter your name and a valid 10-digit phone' shown, 5) fill valid + tap continue → routes to /passenger, 6) role-driver reveals input-vehicle → fill + continue routes to /driver.
